public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Windborne, a Series A climate and energy company founded by John Dean, is valued within a frontier-tech sector represented by a peer universe of 1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. The company has raised $23.4M to date.

Valuation was derived using stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement to the $23.4M total raised proxy, yielding $47M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy set; while 9 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the minimum three-datapoint threshold for narrow-filter peer analysis without introducing material selection bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, with a median point of $47M. This range reflects conservative ($40M, approximately 1.7x raised) through moderate ($54M, approximately 2.3x raised) step-up scenarios. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct-stage peer calibration and reliance on a single methodological anchor. Refinement would benefit from access to recent Series A and Series B closes within climate tech, or disclosed pre-money terms from comparable-tier rounds in the peer set.
